name: Glory Of God
overview: The glory of God is revealed as a powerful and awe-inspiring presence, manifesting visibly as a consuming fire and filling the tabernacle with His majesty, as seen in Exodus 24:17 and 40:34. God's glory is unique and sacred, not to be shared with idols or graven images, affirming His exclusive divine honor (Isaiah 42:8). Believers are called to seek and reflect this glory, which brings light, health, and righteousness, promising that the glory of the LORD will be their reward and fill the earth forever (Exodus 33:18; Isaiah 58:8; Psalms 72:19).
